Questions

 

How do I get a price?

Send clear photos of your furniture on WhatsApp and tell us what finish you want. We will reply with a quote.

Can I choose the colour and finish?

Yes. Natural, dark, gold, antique and high-gloss finishes are all possible. Send a reference photo if you have one.

Do you offer pickup and delivery?

Please ask on WhatsApp with your area, and we will confirm what is possible.
